metas.name: The Serial Killer Connection
metas.description: The ex-wife and survivor of serial killer Richard "Marc" Evonitz unite to uncover his untold life and crimes and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed.

metas.name: A Killer Story
metas.description: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

metas.name: The End of Oak Street
metas.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

metas.name: Monsters of God
metas.description: A gripping documentary explores the shadowy world of exotic reptile smuggling, following two rival kingpins whose lucrative global operation supplied rare species to US zoos until betrayal sparked a devastating vendetta.

metas.name: Euphoria: A Look Back
metas.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

metas.name: The Man Will Burn
metas.description: Traces the evolution of Burning Man, from its anarchic countercultural roots in San Francisco to the 80,000-person desert gathering it has become.

metas.name: The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

metas.name: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
metas.description: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

metas.name: Bring Me the Beauties: A Model Cult
metas.description: Learn how Hoyt Richards was drawn into the spiritual group Eternal Values by its enigmatic leader Frederick von Mierers.

metas.name: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
metas.description: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

metas.name: K-Everything: A CNN Original Series
metas.description: A cultural exploration of Korea’s explosive global influence, K‑Everything, hosted by Daniel Dae Kim, dives into how Korea’s music, film, food, and beauty industries reshaped global culture.

metas.name: Perilous Passage: Birth in America
metas.description: A look at the impact of an already very precarious maternal health state in the U.S. post-rescinding of Roe v. Wade, via the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, reversing rights that women have been working so hard to fight for, and that will actually have a deep impact that we can't even see just yet in terms of the numbers of mortality and trauma as a result of those very draconian policies.

metas.name: Half Man
metas.description: Ruben turns up at his estranged brother Niall's wedding, acting as a catalyst for a revival of the last 40 years of their relationship.

metas.name: Normal
metas.description: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

metas.name: The Dark Wizard
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, the world's most influential and controversial climber, base jumper and highline walker, who achieves jaw-dropping feats while battling his inner demons.

metas.name: Boy Band Confidential: A Hollywood Demons Event
metas.description: NSYNC's Joey Fatone exposes the secret machinery behind manufactured superstardom — and its devastating human cost. Candid interviews with artists from Boyz II Men, 98 Degrees, and others reveal the darker realities of power struggles and exploitation.

metas.name: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
metas.description: Follows parents confronting the unthinkable truth that their child has grown into a monster who committed horrifying crimes, featuring first-person interviews.

metas.name: Marc by Sofia
metas.description: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer.

metas.name: Boom Box: Beats and Betrayal
metas.description: In this gripping true crime series, a London studio attracts young rappers with cheap recording sessions, but all is not as it seems.

metas.name: Born to Bowl
metas.description: Liev Schreiber narrates this documentary series that follows five competitors on the Professional Bowlers Association (PBA) Tour.

metas.name: Hunt for the Missing: Chicago
metas.description: In the series, retired Chicago Detective Pamela Childs revisits unsolved missing persons cases as she hopes to uncover new leads and find potential answers for the victims’ families.

metas.name: Lost Women of Alaska
metas.description: The brutal murders of two Alaska Native women and the shocking investigation that led authorities to their sadistic killer

metas.name: Murder in Glitterball City
metas.description: The city of Louisville, Kentucky, known for its historic Victorian architecture and birthplace of the mirrored glitterball, proves to be an unlikely backdrop for a dark tale of murder. This documentary explores the shifting landscape of a mysterious killing, a toxic relationship, a vulnerable victim and the unreliable accounts of two ex-lovers on trial for their lives.

metas.name: DC Air Disaster: Final Minutes Revealed
metas.description: Discovery Channel's DC Air Disaster: Final Minutes Revealed (airing Jan. 29, 2026) investigates the Jan. 29, 2025, midair collision between a PSA Airlines jet and an Army Black Hawk over the Potomac, revealing fatal, un-alerted, last-second failures. The special highlights critical, previously undisclosed NTSB, cockpit audio, and ATC insights

metas.name: I'm Chevy Chase and You're Not
metas.description: Chevy Chase rose to fame on SNL before becoming a movie star in the 1980s. Known for physical comedy and deadpan delivery, his career later declined amid reports of difficult behavior.
